# Hisyam Sayyid Alzam

> Official portfolio and developer profile of Hisyam Sayyid Alzam (hszamm__), Software Developer, UI/UX Designer, and Project Manager specializing in SvelteKit 2, Svelte 5 (Runes), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, and Neobrutalism Web Design.

Hisyam Sayyid Alzam is a software developer and vocational software engineering (RPL) student based in Indonesia. He builds fast, accessible, and clean-architectured web applications, systems, and games with distinctive neobrutalism aesthetics and high performance.

- Canonical URL: https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/

## Core Competencies & Skills

- [Frontend Development](https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/#skills): SvelteKit 2, Svelte 5 (Runes), React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Three.js, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Lenis Smooth Scroll.
- [Backend & APIs](https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/#skills): Node.js, Python, RESTful API design, PostgreSQL, MySQL database normalization.
- [Architecture & Design Standards](https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/#craft): Neobrutalism Design System, Responsive Multi-Screen layouts (mobile, tablet, desktop), Web Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), Clean Code architecture.
- [DevOps & Tooling](https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/#skills): Git, GitHub, GitLab CI/CD, Vercel deployment, Linux environment management.

## Featured Projects

- [UIC Press Publishing Portal](https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/#projects): Digital publishing portal for Universitas Ibnu Chaldun. Project manager and developer handling book cataloging, ISBN tracking, and administrative workflows.
- [Web-Based Educational Game Platform](https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/#projects): Multi-game web platform featuring Puzzle 2048, Tic Tac Toe, Math Challenge, Word Search, Bubble Shooter, and Flappy mechanics with dark/light themes.
- [Organization Financial Management System](https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/#projects): Real-time cashflow dashboard with financial ledger recording, income/expense reports, and transparent fund tracking.
- [Custom Cashier POS System](https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/#projects): Flexible point-of-sale software with dynamic item pricing, receipt printing, and comprehensive sales history logs.
- [Digital Organization Invitation & Guestbook](https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/#projects): Interactive digital event invitations with live RSVP check-in, guest greetings, and automated attendance counters.
- [Shortlink LinkKu](https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/#projects): Fast URL shortener service with click analytics, custom alias generation, and link security checks.
- [Putra Sunda Jaya Company Profile](https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/#projects): Corporate landing page featuring interactive service catalogs and direct inquiry routing.
